_schema: Mandate / product-eligibility file read by plb/mandate.py. A product qualifies when status in {open, rolling} AND (eligible_programs empty or intersects programs_list) AND owner_type not in ineligible_owner_types AND (eligible_owner_types empty or owner_type in it) AND units >= min_units (units, not units_at_risk) AND (application_window absent or as_of inside it). mandate_fit = eligible if any product qualifies; ineligible if products exist and none qualifies (mandate_ineligible_reason = first failing test per product); no_mandate_file when the pack has no mandate.json. Route-level hard filter on nofa_offer only: never an exclusion reason, never a multiplier. Every product is a placeholder with verified_live false until the agency pastes its own NOFA terms.
